test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**rooted**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage discusses how the early nationalists founded their nationalism on a detailed analysis of imperialism.
 
• The appropriate verb indicates establishing a foundation based on thorough analysis.
 
• "**Rooted**" fits well as it denotes establishing firmly and deeply.
 
• Other options ("**minded**", "**controlled**", "**drove**") do not convey the sense of foundational establishment that "**rooted**" does.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.
